title: AdHocQueryExecutionRequest
description: Request to execute an ad-hoc query. Supply exactly one mode: adhoc_query_id to run a saved query, or query_view_id plus select_fields to run an inline (transient) query. Synchronous by default; set execute_async to run deferred and poll for the result.

adhoc_query_id.description: ID of a saved query to execute (saved mode). Mutually exclusive with query_view_id. When supplied, the field collections are loaded from the saved definition and any inline select_fields are ignored.

query_view_id.description: ID of the query view to execute against (inline mode). Mutually exclusive with adhoc_query_id. Stable across environments, so safe to embed in caller code.

select_fields.description: Output (Select) fields. Required (at least one) for inline execution; ignored in saved mode.

filter_fields.description: Filter fields (WHERE-clause predicates). Inline mode only.

sort_fields.description: Sort fields (ORDER BY). Inline mode only.

group_filter_fields.description: Group-filter fields (HAVING-clause predicates over aggregates). Inline mode only.

do_return_data.description: When false, only the generated SQL and field metadata are returned — no rows. Defaults to true. The generated SQL is surfaced on the response sql field.

bypass_record_count.description: When true, the total record count is not computed for result sets larger than the page — faster, but row_count comes back null. Defaults to false.

include_security_sql.description: When true, the individual record-access security SQL clauses are returned alongside the result (on the sql field). Defaults to false.

suppress_duplicate_rows.description: Suppress duplicate full rows in the output. Only collapses identical rows — does not collapse a one-to-many row expansion.

suppress_primary_key_field.description: When true, the synthetic QUERYRECID primary-key column is omitted from output. Defaults to false (the key is included).

max_records.description: Cap on rows returned. A server-side ceiling is applied separately.

start.description: Paging offset (zero-based). When set with limit, returns a slice.

limit.description: Paging page size. Pairs with start.

context_record_id.description: Context record ID for query views that require one (table-valued-function views).

search_text.description: Free-text search applied across the query's output fields.

execute_async.description: When true, run asynchronously (deferred): the response returns immediately with status `deferred`, a deferred_result_key, and an infinity_session instead of blocking for the result. Poll GetAdHocQueryExecution — and optionally cancel via DeleteAdHocQueryExecution — passing both values back. Defaults to false (synchronous: the result set is returned inline with status `ready`).

column_name.description: Column name on the object. Required.

filter_operator.description: Filter operator (e.g. IsEqualTo, IsOneOf, IsBlank, BeginsWith). Required for the row to be applied.

compare_type.description: Boolean connector to the previous filter (None, And, Or). The first filter typically uses None.

values.description: Comparison values. Most operators need one; IsOneOf / IsBetween need more.

data_type.description: Data type of the values (String, Integer, Date, Money, Boolean, Guid, etc.). Optional for most operators.

include_blanks.description: When true, blank values in the source pass the filter alongside the comparison.

is_id_set_field.description: True when this filter references an ID set (selection) rather than a scalar.

left_parenthesis_count.description: Number of opening parens to emit when nested deeper than one level.

right_parenthesis_count.description: Number of closing parens to emit when nested deeper than one level.

AdHocQueryFilterField.description: One element of filter_fields (a WHERE-clause predicate).

object_name.description: Object name the aggregate runs over.

AdHocQueryGroupFilterField.description: One element of group_filter_fields (a HAVING-clause predicate over an aggregate).

column_name.description: Column name on the object. Required.

parent_path.description: Query-view join path leading to the object. Required for every select field; for root-table fields it equals object_name (defaulted when omitted). For joined fields, supply the full backslash-delimited path (e.g. V_QUERY_CONSTITUENT\Interactions).

display_path.description: Human-readable join-path display. Used in error messages and output column captions; usually mirrors parent_path.

alias_name.description: Alias to apply to the output column. Optional; one is generated when omitted.

aggregate_type.description: Aggregate to apply (None, Count, Sum, Min, Max, Average).

is_id_set_field.description: True when this field references an ID set (selection) rather than a scalar column.

is_hidden.description: Suppresses the field from output while still allowing it to participate in filter/sort/group expressions.

AdHocQuerySelectField.description: One element of select_fields. Field names map 1:1 to the underlying query definition.

alias_name.description: Output-column alias to sort on. Either this or field_name must be supplied.

field_name.description: Raw field reference, typically in ObjectName.ColumnName form.

sort_order.description: Ascending or Descending. Defaults to Ascending when omitted.

AdHocQuerySortField.description: One element of sort_fields (an ORDER BY entry). Each sort field must reference a select field.
